info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server…
info.description:
RESTful API for deploying, undeploying, redeploying, and managing applications and shared libraries on Oracle WebLogic Server. Supports uploading application archives, deploying from the server file system, managing deployment plans, and controlling application lifecycle states across servers and clusters.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
